_comment: Read-only connectors of the agentic Slack lot 1. One entry per connector: mount it with `mount-connector.sh <name> --preset`. approvals: MNDT_API stays in approvals.env as deployed today; deciding is denied twice (env and proxy). Secrets never live here: each entry names an env file under /data/mndt/live/connectors, mode 600. allow/deny are tool-name patterns (trailing * = prefix); deny wins. The proxy refuses every tool outside allow before the call reaches the server. Code and dependencies of qonto (mcp-remote, pinned by runtime/qonto.package-lock.json), dolibarr and swing (Python, pinned by runtime/*.requirements.txt) are installed under the tenant's tools folder by tenant/install-connectors.sh; nothing is fetched when the workbench starts. qonto: every tool that answers with a presigned download URL (attachments, statements) is denied. machine: « Mon ordinateur », in computer mode only (MACHINES_MODE=pc): every tool acts on the computer of the person the running turn acts for, through the API (as that person, with the gateway's secret from its file); the connector holds no machine token. A submit asks a card first. Every connector runs under Landlock (render-connectors.py): it reads the system, the image and its tools, writes /tmp and /state/mcp-auth, and reads of /state only its readPaths; gatewaySecret (approvals, machine) grants the gateway's secret, from this catalog only, to a descriptor whose command is the catalog's.
